name: PocketBase
tagline: Open Source realtime backend in 1 file
description: PocketBase is an open-source backend solution that combines a real-time database, authentication, file storage, and an admin dashboard into a single, portable executable.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  pocketbase:
    image: argonptg/pocketbase:0.26.6
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024M
    network_mode: bridge
    ports:
      - target: 8090
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: always
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/pb_data
        target: /pb_data
    container_name: pocketbase
